author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Grand Theft Auto 6 went up for preorder a few weeks ago, and it's already sold $260 million worth of early purchases. According to analysts at Newzoo, the game is on track to hit between $3 and $5 billion dollars in the first week. Yes, that's BILLIONS of dollars in sales in Week 1. By comparison, GTA 5 made $1.15 billion in its first week at a lower price point than GTA 6 will be launched at. In other news, a player in AC Black Flag Resynced accidentally found the treasure in an upcoming in-game event, causing Ubisoft to cancel the event, while praising that player's treasure-hunting skills. And finally, an in-person Pokémon Go event in New York saw attendees sell their rare Mewtwos for thousands of dollars on eBay, much to the disgust of many fans.

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
title: GTA 6 Could Earn Over $3 Billion Week One - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Palworld version 1.0 has arrived, bringing a massive wave of new content and changes, including the highly sought-after midgame crafting material: Hardwood. If you're starting fresh and wondering how to track down this vital new resource, we've got you covered with the best strategies and locations to keep your inventory stocked.

In this guide, we break down exactly where to find and farm Hardwood in Palworld. We explain how to hunt for new schematics at Icy Weasel Hill and lower-level dungeons, before heading out to harvest mesquite trees in the Twilight Dunes or cherry trees near the Dancing Sakura Shrine. You'll also learn the exact materials needed to build the Logging Site II at level 43, allowing you to passively generate Hardwood right at your camp and avoid dangerous encounters with high-level Pals.

#IGN #Gaming #Palworld
title: How to Get Hardwood in Palworld 1.0

description:
Are you struggling to track down the Needle in the haystacks or figure out how to scale the orange crane for the Flip Cellphone? Storage Hunters: Open World has 29 cleverly hidden lost items scattered across the map, from the depths of the lake to the top of the Shipyard's grain silos. Whether you need the Key to unlock the Scythe or just want to test your parkour skills, this complete video guide will help you collect every single one.

In this Roblox Storage Hunters: Open World guide, we show you the exact locations of all 29 lost items to complete your collection. Watch to discover how to easily find tricky collectibles like the Digital Alarm Clock in the false wall of the Grading Shop, the Typewriter on the grey metal tower, and the Acoustic Guitar high up in the city. Remember to grab the Key beneath the bridge first, as you will need it to unlock the Back Alley warehouse for the Scythe. Our complete walkthrough covers the Farmyard, Shipyard, Junkyard, Shopping Mall, and more to
title: Storage Hunters: Open World - All 29 Lost Items Locations Guide

After playing Beast of Reincarnation's opening hours, it's clear developer Game Freak is shooting for something bigger, more ambitious, and simply different from anything it's previously made. The film centers on a legendary leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. As war burns across England, he forms an army of the people to face the King’s might in a fight for justice and survival.

The Uprising stars Andrew Garfield, Jamie Bell, Stephen Dillane, Tom Hollander, Cosmo Jarvis, Thomasin McKenzie, Jonny Lee Miller, Woody Norman, Katherine Waterston, Sky Yang, and more. The film is written and directed by Paul Greengrass and produced by Jason Blum, Paul Greengrass, Gregory Goodman, Joanna Kaye, Joe Neurauter, and Lars Sylvest.

The Uprising is in theaters on September 11.

author: IGN
description:
Ever since Obsidian and Bethesda found themselves under the same roof at Xbox, a proper follow-up to Fallout: New Vegas has been tantalisingly possible, but it never seemed like a priority for either company. Well, that's reportedly about to change: reports from Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier indicate that Obsidian Entertainment is officially working on a new Fallout project, with New Vegas director Josh Sawyer back at the helm. While this is the exact holy grail of RPG announcements that we've all been hoping for, it has come at an unfathomable cost, amid mass layoffs at Xbox and an absolute gutting of talent at both of their beloved RPG stables.

 New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has mandated the studios in her charge to start playing the hits, meaning more Fallout, Elder Scrolls, and Halo. This is arguably something that should have happened years ago, before laying off hundreds of the developers who actually build these things. But her predecessor Phil Spencer operated, as much as possible, a
title: We Want Fallout New Vegas 2, But Not Like This

author: IGN
description:
Welcome to IGN's Watch List, a rundown of the 5 things we're most excited about this week! Apple TV goes underground again for Season 3 of Silo, House of the Dragon brings the heat again after a talk-y few episodes, get ready for a trip back to Arlen for some propane accessories when King of the Hill returns, plus X-Men '97 pivots back to a villain-of-the-week formula! But of course this weeks biggest drop, Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey hits theaters this weekend. Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson, Zendaya and just about every other actor you've heard of bring the ancient epic poem to IMAX sized screens. But where is this one going to rank among the rest of Nolan's filmography? IGN's Reviewer of the film, Scott Collura joins Michael Peyton and host Clint Gage to talk about Nolan's three best, and whether or not Odysseus has a chance of finding his way to the top.

This is IGN's Watch List!
title: The Odyssey Reviewer On Nolan's Top 3 Films + This Week's Best Series | IGN Watch List

description:
Check out the Langrisser: Sea of Sword teaser trailer for the next fantasy tactical RPG in the Langrisser series. Langrisser: Sea of Sword is developed by BlackJack Studio (the original team behind Langrisser Mobile), with a new score by composer Yasunori Nishiki. 

In Langrisser: Sea of Sword, you become the Nameless, a figure searching for lost memories from the shadows. Alongside a mysterious white-haired girl, you rise from mire and mist into a world of shifting loyalties, impossible choices, and nations standing on the brink. Across the mist-shrouded sea, hidden currents begin to stir, and a new saga unfolds.

Classic strategy is the key to breaking through the chaos. Amid the flames of war, every move, every formation, and every decision will shape the course of fate.

Langrisser: Sea of Sword is set for a global multi-platform release across iOS, Android, PC, Steam, and more. Global pre-registration is now open across multiple platforms.
